title: CrowdReply Grok Bot setup for AI-answer citation outreach via MCP
summary: CrowdReply amplifies Dawood's X article as a three-step Grok Bot workflow: install a Chief of AI Visibility bot, connect CrowdReply MCP, and run six citation-outreach bots that find cited pages and place brand mentions to move ChatGPT/Grok/Perplexity visibility.
question_it_answers: How do I wire Grok Bots plus CrowdReply MCP to run citation outreach for AI-answer visibility?

claims.text: Setup is three steps: install a Grok bot as Chief of AI Visibility, connect CrowdReply MCP, and feed the article prompts.
claims.evidence:
1. install grok bot and make it your Chief of AI Visibility
2. connect CrowdReply MCP
3. feed it the article below with all prompts
claims.subject: serp-ai-visibility

claims.text: Quoted article reports an online design tool moved from 4% to 40% AI visibility in 11 weeks via citation outreach.
claims.evidence: Receipt in the article: an online design tool 4% → 40% visibility in 11 weeks
claims.subject: serp-ai-visibility

claims.text: CrowdReply MCP docs list 18+ tools with visibility reads and write actions behind two-step confirmation.
claims.evidence: Docs list 18+ tools (visibility/citations read; create_task etc. writes behind two-step confirm).
claims.subject: serp-ai-visibility

claims.text: fxtwitter article 2094451432208711681 (carrier dawoodkhan254/2094451439573881015) is 165 blocks / 150 nonempty / 14,763 chars. It does contain 4%→40% in 11 weeks, plus 847 cited domains / ~10% closed / 85 mentions, 76→127 of 847 cited pages, and 2→9 of 17 ChatGPT sources.
claims.evidence: We took an online design tool from 4% to 40% visibility in 11 weeks. 847 cited domains on the list. Around 10% closed. 85 mentions. On the one ChatGPT question that mattered most they went from 2 of 17 source pages to 9 of 17.
claims.subject: serp-ai-visibility

claims.text: Article names six Grok bots — Chief of Staff, Scout, Finder, Writer, Closer, Watcher — and claims 1,860+ offsite mentions across 10,000+ brands. That is first-party article copy, not a tracker export.
claims.evidence: The 6 bots: CrowdReply - Chief of Staff / Scout / Finder / Writer / Closer / Watcher. 1,860+ offsite mentions. 10,000+ brands.
claims.subject: serp-ai-visibility
